page.title: Snapshot inspector
page.description: Open a tinyactors snapshot in your browser and read its memory: each segment's pools, every actor by state, and an actor's record and mailbox.

playground.description: The Inspector opens a sample snapshot of 51 actors: orders and the payments they invoked. It shows each segment's memory by pool, every actor slot by state, and one actor's record field by field with its mailbox.
